_comment: Committed PDK defaults for this repo. Environment variables win over this
file, and sim/pdk.local.json (git-ignored) wins over both.
name            drives the GF180_PDK_PATH env var and the deck headers.
default_variant gf180mcu flavor directory to use (5LM / metal_top 11K).
model_lib       the model .lib file corner sections are read from,
relative to the variant directory. Its top-level corner
design_include  the PDK's global switches/params include (Monte Carlo
switch defaults), included ahead of the model library.
search_roots    extra directories that CONTAIN variant dirs, searched
/usr/share/pdk, ...). ~/.ciel is prepended so a box with
both a ciel and a volare store resolves to the ciel
install, whose enabled revision is the one pinned in
sim/toolchain.json -- the same revision CI installs.
name: gf180
